item.title: The "Mad Men" in 4K on HBO Max Debacle
item.description:
📝 Yeah, you're not supposed to see that. Somehow, this episode (along with many others) do not include all the digital visual effects that were in the original broadcasts and home video releases. • • • • •I want to be clear that this is a separate issue than the "reframed original film negative for 16:9" issue that has plagued many restorations that have left viewers scratching their heads.
🔗 Read more: http://fxrant.blogspot.com/2025/12/the-mad-men-in-4k-on-hbo-max-debacle.html
